# App Modernization assessment

Use only when the activation context grants this exact capability and stage.

1. Bind every conclusion to the current inventory digest and exact repository SHA.
2. Separate maintainability, architecture, risk, compatibility, constraints, and unknowns.
3. Preserve behavior, deny production effects, and request human clarification for material uncertainty.
4. Refuse stale predecessors, cross-demo evidence, prompt-selected targets, or expanded tools.

Return target-free advisory content only.
